items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Dicky Wells on trombone... [INTERVIEWEE] Now, is this the one that was at the Empire Ballroom with me?

ctx.x: This is August, September. I think that’s . . . the first confirmed personnel of that band would be, on trumpets, Leonard Davis; Lewis Bacon [phonetic], Dicky Wells on trombone, Chu Berry, Hilton Jefferson, and Wayman Carver on reeds.
Now, is this the one that was at the Empire Ballroom with me?
